target_customer: Marketplaces, media and e-commerce companies needing recommendations and search
problem: Building real-time ranking and recommendation systems in house is slow and expensive.
business_model: Platform subscription for recommendation and retrieval APIs

founders.name: Tullie Murrell
founders.background_notes: Created PyTorchVideo and was an early core contributor to PyTorch Lightning.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time ML ranking infrastructure across arbitrary customer data needs deep recommender and systems expertise.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with customer data and models creates some lock-in, but cloud vendors and search vendors offer overlapping products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Shaped was not copied away; it was acquired by Whatnot in July 2026 and its team joined Whatnot's applied AI group.

market_need_then: Personalization and feed ranking were costly in-house work for mid-size marketplaces; TechCrunch coverage in 2024 describes demand for self-serve alternatives.

branding.domain_note: Uses shaped.ai; acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Known in ML infrastructure circles; generic word name; no brand-specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Shaped, founded by a former Facebook AI researcher, raised an 8 million dollar Series A led by Madrona in July 2024 and was acquired by Whatnot in July 2026 for undisclosed terms. It ended as a team and technology acquisition rather than a large independent outcome.
